prompt: In which general elections (year) was Makhdum Khusro Bakhtyar (Pakistani politician) re-elected to the National Assembly as an independent candidate from Constituency NA-194 (Rahim Yar Khan-III)?
answer: 2013. He was re-elected as an independent candidate from NA-194 (Rahim Yar Khan-III) in the 2013 Pakistani general election.
